known_limitations: lzbench calls BrotliEncoderCompress one-shot; the project uses the same vendored implementation through its streaming API so PROCESS and FINISH satisfy the mandatory lifecycle contract.
The registered variant fixes quality 5, lgwin 22, generic mode, one CPU thread, no external dictionary, and the built-in Brotli static dictionary.

BrotliDecoderDecompress does not distinguish every destination-too-small case; the adapter supplies the independently declared exact destination length and maps remaining decode failures to a stable codec error.
Brotli has no embedded uncompressed-length field, so independent allocation length comes from the versioned TSCB descriptor.
LeakSanitizer cannot run under the host container ptrace policy; ASan/UBSan qualification uses detect_leaks=0.
